Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 39: the slip of [[Unexpected Interruption (V)#Source formats|Unexpected Interruption (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“If a battle was just initiated, target an opponent's female non-droid character present with Xizor. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 > target's ability, target excluded from battle and adds her power to Xizor's for remainder of turn.”), word for word the text of [[Unexpected Interruption (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
